chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from al-'Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him how one performs the prayer over men and women, and he said: The man is placed nearest to where the men are, and the women are behind the men.

key_terms.الرِّجَالِ: the men, referring here to male deceased and the men’s side
key_terms.النِّسَاءِ: the women, referring here to female deceased

ai.seo_question: How should the جنازة of men and women be arranged together for funeral prayer in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the arrangement of male and female جنازة during funeral prayer when they are gathered together. It indicates that the male deceased is placed closer to the side of the men, while the female deceased are placed behind the men.
